description: This file defines the LocalPlugin class within the WPEFramework::Plugin::Rust namespace. The class implements the Rust::IPlugin interface and provides methods for plugin lifecycle management, invocation, and communication with Rust code. It also includes function pointers for Rust plugin operations and maintains internal state such as reference counts and plugin handles.

classes.name: LocalPlugin
classes.description: A plugin class that interfaces with Rust code, manages plugin lifecycle, and handles communication between the host and Rust backend.
